name: Gurugram
description: Millennium City and the starting point for all TripGraph routes. Well-connected to Delhi NCR via expressways.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City of Rajasthan, famous for Amber Fort, palaces, bazaars, and Rajasthani cuisine.

name: Rishikesh
description: Yoga and adventure capital of India. River rafting, Ganga Aarti, riverside cafes, and Himalayan foothills.

name: Tirthan Valley
description: Remote Himalayan valley in Himachal Pradesh, bordering the Great Himalayan National Park. Pristine rivers, trout fishing, and untouched nature.
